title: SPARC Project Configuration
description: Schema for a SPARC spatial regression pipeline project file (project.yml)

domain.description: Domain template used (e.g. uhi, groundwater, air_quality)

response_units.description: Units of the target/response variable (used in reports and physics priors)

file_path.description: Path to input CSV (absolute or relative to project.yml)

target_column.description: Name of the response/target variable column

areas_of_interest_file.description: Optional CSV mapping locations to named zones/districts for scenario analysis

input.description: EPSG code of the input data CRS (e.g. EPSG:4326)

projected.description: EPSG code of the target projected CRS for spatial analysis

predictors.description: List of predictor column names in the input data

physics.description: Physics/domain constraints — priors, caps, monotonicity, causal DAG

priors_file.description: Path to priors YAML (literature coefficients, scale harmonization)

caps_file.description: Path to caps YAML (variable bounds, delta constraints, monotonicity)

monotone_constraints.description: Per-predictor monotonicity: -1 = decreasing effect, +1 = increasing, 0 = unconstrained

causal.description: Causal DAG configuration for counterfactual simulation

dag_file.description: Path to causal DAG definition (JSON or YAML — nodes + directed edges)

estimator.description: Structural-equation estimator: ols (linear), hgb (HistGradientBoosting, non-linear), or dml (Debiased/Doubly-robust ML, recommended for causal inference)

dml_shrinkage.description: Physics prior shrinkage weight for DML estimator (reduced vs default since DML is debiased)

dml_cv_folds.description: Number of cross-fitting folds for DML estimation

spatial_block_size.description: Block size in meters for spatial DML cross-fitting (null = auto from correlogram)

dag_blend_weight.description: Weight for DAG causal coefficients vs physics priors in scenario simulation (higher = more trust in data)

estimate_cate.description: Whether to estimate Conditional Average Treatment Effects via EconML

ipw_enabled.description: Run IPW ATE estimation alongside backdoor regression

gps_enabled.description: Run Generalized Propensity Score estimation for continuous treatments

matching_enabled.description: Run covariate matching cross-check for ATE estimation

doubly_robust.description: Run doubly-robust estimation via LinearDML (continuous treatment)

dose_response.description: Compute dose-response curves (non-linear treatment effect analysis)

bootstrap_n.description: Number of bootstrap iterations for ATE confidence intervals

actionable_variables.description: Variables that can be intervened on (subset of predictors)

temporal_edges.description: Time-lagged causal edges for spatiotemporal models (e.g. last month's rainfall causes this month's groundwater level)

lag.description: Number of time steps the effect is delayed

discovery.description: Causal discovery settings for data-driven DAG validation

enabled.description: Run causal discovery algorithms to validate expert DAG

methods.description: Which algorithms to run (pcmci requires temporal data)

compare_expert.description: Compare data-learned DAG with expert DAG

consensus_threshold.description: Minimum number of methods agreeing per edge for consensus DAG

base_dir.description: Base output directory (relative to project.yml or absolute)

run_mc_uncertainty.description: Run Monte-Carlo uncertainty propagation on scenarios

n_mc_draws.description: Number of MC draws for uncertainty propagation

scenario_mode.description: Scenario prediction mode: auto (hybrid if DAG exists, else physics-only), dag_coefficient (MGWR+DAG), model_reprediction (base-model consensus), hybrid (model consensus direct + DAG indirect)

temporal_holdout_fraction.description: Fraction of most recent time steps to hold out for temporal validation (0 = disabled)

run_sensitivity_analysis.description: Run global sensitivity analysis on physics priors

sensitivity_method.description: Sensitivity analysis method (morris is faster, sobol is quantitative)

models.description: Per-model hyperparameters (all optional — sensible defaults used if omitted)

enabled.description: Enable Deep Kriging V2 residual correction when spatial autocorrelation is detected in meta-ensemble residuals.

version.description: Deep Kriging version. 2 = multi-scale Wendland basis + spatial smoothness (recommended).

block_size.description: Block size in meters. null = auto-detect from correlogram.

block_size_source.description: Source of block_size: user-specified or auto-detected from correlogram

spatial_cv.description: Use spatial block CV instead of random k-fold (default: false; standard k-fold is sufficient for screening)

block_size.description: Block size in meters for GWEN spatial CV. If null, inherits from models.spatial_cv.block_size

local_cv.description: Run per-location ElasticNetCV. When false, reuse global alpha for local models (much faster)

stability_folds.description: Number of folds for stability scoring (0 to disable; overkill for screening)

quick_mode.description: Fast mode: fixed alpha, reduced fit locations

scenarios.description: Single-variable intervention scenarios for counterfactual simulation

auto_propagate_dag.description: Whether to propagate effects through the causal DAG

temporal.description: Spatiotemporal configuration for panel/time-series data. When enabled, SPARC treats rows as location×time observations.

enabled.description: Enable spatiotemporal mode (requires time_column in data)

time_column.description: Column name containing timestamps or integer time indices

training_window.description: Number of time steps to use for training (null = use all available)

validation_window.description: Number of future time steps reserved for temporal validation

forecast_horizon.description: Number of future time steps to forecast beyond the last observed period (0 = no forecasting)

lags.description: Lag steps to create (e.g. [1,2,3] creates t-1, t-2, t-3 features)

rolling_windows.description: Rolling window sizes for mean/std aggregation features

variables.description: Subset of predictors to lag (default: all predictors if omitted)

method.description: CV strategy: expanding uses growing history, sliding uses fixed window, spatiotemporal_block jointly blocks space and time

gap.description: Number of time steps to skip between train and test sets (prevents leakage from autocorrelation)

method.description: How to aggregate multi-temporal data per location. 'none' keeps full panel data.

period.description: Aggregation period (e.g. 'monthly', 'annual'). null = aggregate across all time steps.

benchmark_metrics.description: Extended evaluation metrics for climate model benchmarking (nRMSE, pattern correlation, amplitude ratio)

enabled.description: Compute benchmark metrics (nRMSE, pattern correlation, amplitude ratio) in Stage 2 evaluation

area_weighted.description: Weight pattern correlation by cos(lat) for gridded data on regular lat-lon grids

lat_column.description: Column name for latitude (degrees) used in area weighting. null = auto-detect from coord_columns.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprinting hybrid layer — project SPARC predictions onto a known forced spatial pattern

enabled.description: Enable fingerprint projection post-processing on meta-ensemble predictions

pattern_source.description: Source of the target forced pattern: ensemble-mean truth field, leading EOF of member spread, or both for comparison

eof_n_modes.description: Number of EOF modes to retain when pattern_source includes 'eof'

blend_alpha.description: Blending weight: final = alpha * projected + (1 - alpha) * raw_prediction

truth_column.description: Column containing the forced-response truth field (e.g. 'tos_trend_forced'). null = auto '{target}_forced'.
